reasoning_summary: Selected features cover broad credit-risk semantic groups including credit score, delinquency behavior, indebtedness, utilization, capacity, and customer history. Features with low missingness and stable, interpretable definitions were prioritized. Redundant features were controlled by preferring representative aggregates or ratios over multiple similar variants. Flags and bands were included to capture stable categorical or threshold effects. Features with high missingness or operational brittleness were excluded. The selection balances stable out-of-time generalization, coverage, interpretability, and durability for downstream modeling.
